FULL TEXT:
a
The West Bengal Central School Service Commission
ACHARYA SADAN, 11&11/1, Block-EE, Salt Lake, Kolkata-700091
PUBLIC NOTICE
PERMISSION FOR APPEARING IN INTERVIEW-CUM-LECTURE DEMONSTRATION
ON 24.12.2025 IN C/W 2ND SLST(AT), 2025 FOR CLASS LEVEL XI-XII
DUE TO WEBSITE SERVER DOWN ISSUE
Memo No. : 2660/7016/CSSC/ESTT/2025 Date: 23.12.2025
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that due to certain technical
issues with the website, some candidates may not have been able to download their
intimation letters for the Interview dated 24.12.2025.
Such candidates will be permitted to appear for the Interview-cum-Lecture
Demonstration, provided they produce other relevant documents that were required to
be carried at the time of document verification.
The website is expected to function smoothly from 24.12.2025 onwards. Therefore,
candidates appearing for the Interview-cum-Lecture Demonstration from 26.12.2025
will not face any difficulty in downloading the intimation letters and must carry the
same as per usual instructions.
Sd/-
Chairman
West Bengal Central School Service Commission
